author: Joshua Fluke
description:
Employee appreciation after 20, 30, even 40 years of service apparently means cupcakes, cakes, certificates, balloons, snacks and an awkward photo for the company Facebook page.

One worker gives a company 27 years and gets a cupcake. Another works 34 years and gets cupcakes. Others spend 30, 35 or 40 years at the same company and get a cake, a piece of paper, a plaque, some balloons or whatever happens to be available in the store that day.

And once I started looking through these employee anniversary posts, they just kept going.

In this video, we’re looking at employee appreciation, work anniversaries, employee recognition, company loyalty, years of service, corporate culture and what companies actually do when someone gives them decades of their working life.

There’s nothing inherently wrong with cake, flowers, snacks or celebrating an anniversary.

The weird part is when a corporation makes a giant public spectacle out of how much it supposedly appreciates someone after decades
title: 40 YEARS OF LOYALTY… HERE IS YOUR REWARD
